recommended_smallest_task.status: Conditional design, unimplemented. Qualify the full cohort before freezing it.
recommended_smallest_task.inputs: Original issuer release or EX-99.1, previous qualified release, 20 prior price bars and facts known by the cutoff. Exclude future labels and full transcripts at call start.
recommended_smallest_task.decision: Issue after an independently checked SEC acceptance or dissemination cutoff plus declared latency, before the first eligible regular open. For ambiguous or held-over filings, use a later eligible open or abstain.
recommended_smallest_task.target: Stock return from the entry Open to the fifth session Close minus SPY over the exact same window, with declared costs. Exclude the already realized release-to-open gap. This measures post-entry drift; it does not establish a causal announcement reaction.
recommended_smallest_task.mechanism_test: Compare semantic reasoning and critic with a matched numerical anchor on identical eligible events. First test controlled errors with known origins so measured diagnosis and repair do not depend on noisy market outcomes.
recommended_smallest_task.expectations: No genuine pre-release analyst consensus was verified. Year-over-year growth is not earnings surprise. Management guidance must come from available source text rather than future quarter results.
recommended_smallest_task.corporate_action_gate: Establish the split/dividend adjustment convention or predeclare corporate-action handling. Supplied action flags permit an audit; they do not prove that adding cash dividends is correct.
recommended_smallest_task.evaluation: Define events and cohort from clocks and text coverage before observing returns. Separate chronological splits and overlapping event windows. Modern model pretraining contamination remains unresolved.
